requiredScenarios.description: User signs up, verifies email when required, signs in with password, and receives a project-scoped session.
User completes GitHub OAuth against the real provider and returns to the customer app.
User completes Google OAuth against the real provider and returns to the customer app.
OAuth state, trusted origin, hosted UI origin, and callback URI handling survive redirects.
Email OTP is delivered through a real provider, verified once, and rejected on replay.
Phone OTP is delivered over SMS, verified, rate-limited, and linked to a real session.
Phone OTP is delivered over WhatsApp, verified, rate-limited, and linked to a real session.
Passkey registration and sign-in work in a real browser with the configured RP ID and origin.
TOTP enrollment, challenge, recovery-code handling, and step-up are verified.
Logout clears active browser session state and prevents reuse of protected routes.
Session refresh preserves valid sessions, rejects expired sessions, and respects revocation.
Hosted UI completes auth, sets the right cookies, and redirects to the configured callback.
Customer app receives the return from hosted UI and can fetch the authenticated user.
A consumer Convex app validates Banata-issued JWTs and rejects wrong audience, issuer, or revoked token claims.
Organization membership, role assignment, and permission checks work end to end.
Sessions, provider credentials, users, organizations, API keys, webhooks, and audit logs cannot cross project boundaries.
